decisions.reason: As a prominently presented extension of the firm's established psychiatric and therapeutic services that has already survived one review cycle, management is likely to stay committed and interpret any remaining problems as temporary rather than reverse course.

The dedicated launch and the investment implied by a carpentry workshop create commitment, and because it fits the firm's rehabilitation and practical production capabilities management is inclined to continue despite some risk that it is less central than care services.

Even with lower public visibility, outpatient sociotherapy is close to the core support portfolio, so management is likely to persist with it and justify continuation through strategic fit and gradual ramp-up.

Meal delivery for seniors is related to the firm's eldercare direction, but as a newer and less visibly committed offer it is the easiest to withdraw if uptake disappoints, even though management would still initially prefer to give it more time.
